measurement_protocol.method: single reviewer visual pass from saved desktop and mobile screenshots
measurement_protocol.note: Scores are screenshot-review inputs for the loop gate, not yet automated computer-vision scoring.

strengths: Map, recommendation queue, place detail, and ontology inspector form a coherent product surface.
Palette feels quiet, local, and sensory without becoming a generic beige travel UI.
Real place photos and sensory evidence give the interface concrete substance.
Mobile layout preserves the same workflow and keeps controls readable.
risks: The dense desktop map/list/detail composition is effective but close to the upper limit for first-scan complexity.
Some small metadata labels and relation rows could use more breathing room or stronger typographic contrast.
The distinctive signature is solid but still mostly expressed through structure rather than a memorable brand mark.
